premise: Bear cub doesn't want to miss a single thing all winter, but his yawns win; Badger digs him a cosy hollow, Flower folds up too, and when the spring sun comes they wake up together.
inspiration: Rip Van Winkle, turned: the long sleep is safe, a friend keeps a promise, and nothing good was missed.
lesson: Friends keep watch while you rest.
learning: Bears sleep through most of the winter.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Sleeps Till Spring
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} It was autumn, and the leaves {sfx:leaves} came twirling down. {bear:enter} Bear cub gave a great big yawn. {bear:face sad} [sad] "I don't want to sleep all winter. I'll miss everything!" {badger:enter} {badger:go to bear} Badger trotted up. [warmly] "I'll wake you for the best bit. Promise." {badger:live dig} He dug a cosy hollow, just bear-sized. {badger:face happy} Beside them, {flower:enter} Flower {flower:tint #BFE3FF} shivered and {flower:live close hold} folded up her petals. "See you in spring," she whispered. {bear:face happy} So Bear cub {bear:go to flower} sat down in the hollow and {bear:live nap hold} gave one last yawn. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Then the snowflakes came, and Bear cub slept all winter long, the way bears do. {sfx:snore} He slept… and slept… and slept. And Badger kept watch. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} One morning, the sun came back and melted the snow. {badger:go to bear} Badger tiptoed over. [whispers] "Wake up. It's the best bit." {bear:live nap resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] "Did I miss it?" {badger:live laugh} "No," laughed Badger. "The best bit is now." {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] "Good morning, spring!"

es-ES.title: Osito duerme hasta la primavera
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} Era otoño, y las hojas {sfx:leaves} caían dando vueltas. {bear:enter} Osito soltó un bostezo enorme. {bear:face sad} [sad] —No quiero dormir todo el invierno. ¡Me lo voy a perder todo! {badger:enter} {badger:go to bear} Tejón llegó trotando. [warmly] —Yo te despierto para lo mejor. Te lo prometo. {badger:live dig} Y le cavó un hueco calentito, a la medida de un oso. {badger:face happy} Al lado, {flower:enter} Flor {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tiritó y {flower:live close hold} recogió sus pétalos. —Hasta la primavera —susurró. {bear:face happy} Así que Osito {bear:go to flower} se sentó en el hueco y {bear:live nap hold} dio un último bostezo. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Luego llegaron los copos de nieve, y Osito durmió todo el invierno, como hacen los osos. {sfx:snore} Durmió… y durmió… y durmió. Y Tejón cuidaba de él. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Una mañana volvió el sol y derritió la nieve. {badger:go to bear} Tejón se acercó de puntillas. [whispers] —Despierta, Osito. Ya llega lo mejor. {bear:live nap resume} Osito se despertó de un respingo. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] —¿Me lo he perdido? {badger:live laugh} —¡Qué va! —se rió Tejón—. Lo mejor es ahora. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] —¡Buenos días, primavera!

ja-JP.title: こぐま、はるまで ねむる
ja-JP.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}あきです。木の葉が{sfx:leaves}くるくる、ひらひら。{bear:enter}こぐまが、ふわあっと大あくび。{bear:face sad}[sad]「ふゆじゅうねるなんて、いや。ぜんぶ見のがしちゃう！」 {badger:enter}{badger:go to bear}アナグマくんが、とことこ。[warmly]「いちばんいいときに、おこしてあげる。やくそく。」 {badger:live dig}こぐまにぴったりの、ぬくぬくのくぼみをほりました。{badger:face happy}そばでは{flower:enter}お花が{flower:tint #BFE3FF}ぶるるっ。{flower:live close hold}花びらをとじて、[whispers]「はるにまたね。」 {bear:face happy}こぐまは{bear:go to flower}くぼみにすわって、{bear:live nap hold}さいごのあくびをひとつ。{canvas:leaves stop}{canvas:snow 0.7}やがて雪がふりだすと、こぐまはぐっすり。くまは、ふゆのあいだずっとねむるのです。{sfx:snore}ぐうぐう…ぐうぐう…。アナグマくんは、そばで見まもります。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}ある朝、おひさまがもどって、雪がとけました。{badger:go to bear}アナグマくんが、そーっと。[whispers]「おきて。いちばんいいときだよ。」 {bear:live nap resume}こぐまは、ぱちっと目をさましました。{flower:live close resume}お花も、ぱあっとひらきます。{bear:face surprised}{bear:live talk}[gasps]「ぼく、見のがしちゃった？」 {badger:live laugh}「ううん」 とアナグマくんはわらいました。「いちばんいいのは、いまだよ。」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}[happily]「おはよう、はる！」

de-DE.title: Das Bärchen schläft bis zum Frühling
de-DE.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} Es war Herbst, und die Blätter {sfx:leaves} wirbelten herab. {bear:enter} Das Bärchen gähnte ganz groß: Uaaah! {bear:face sad} [sad] „Ich will nicht den ganzen Winter verschlafen. Dann verpasse ich ja alles!“ {badger:enter} {badger:go to bear} Der Dachs kam angetrabt. [warmly] „Ich wecke dich, wenn das Schönste kommt. Versprochen.“ {badger:live dig} Er grub eine gemütliche Mulde, genau in Bärengröße. {badger:face happy} {flower:enter} Die Blume daneben {flower:tint #BFE3FF} fröstelte und {flower:live close hold} faltete ihre Blütenblätter zusammen. „Bis zum Frühling“, flüsterte sie. {bear:face happy} Also {bear:go to flower} setzte sich das Bärchen in die Mulde und {bear:live nap hold} gähnte ein letztes Mal. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Dann fielen die Schneeflocken, und das Bärchen schlief den ganzen Winter lang, so wie Bären das tun. {sfx:snore} Es schlief… und schlief… und schlief. Und der Dachs hielt Wache. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Eines Morgens kam die Sonne zurück und schmolz den Schnee. {badger:go to bear} Der Dachs schlich auf Zehenspitzen herbei. [whispers] „Aufwachen. Jetzt kommt das Schönste.“ {bear:live nap resume} Das Bärchen wachte mit einem Ruck auf. {flower:live close resume} Die Blume ging weit auf. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] „Hab ich es verpasst?“ {badger:live laugh} „Nein“, lachte der Dachs. „Das Schönste ist jetzt.“ {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] „Guten Morgen, Frühling!“

fr-FR.title: Ourson dort jusqu’au printemps
fr-FR.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} C’était l’automne, et les feuilles {sfx:leaves} tombaient en tourbillonnant. {bear:enter} Ourson a bâillé à s’en décrocher la mâchoire. {bear:face sad} [sad] « Je ne veux pas dormir tout l’hiver. Je vais tout rater ! » {badger:enter} {badger:go to bear} Blaireau est arrivé en trottinant. [warmly] « Je te réveillerai pour le meilleur moment. Promis. » {badger:live dig} Il a creusé un trou douillet, pile à sa taille. {badger:face happy} À côté, {flower:enter} Fleur {flower:tint #BFE3FF} a frissonné et {flower:live close hold} a refermé ses pétales. « À bientôt, au printemps », a-t-elle chuchoté. {bear:face happy} Alors Ourson {bear:go to flower} s’est blotti dedans et {bear:live nap hold} a bâillé une dernière fois. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Puis les flocons sont tombés, et Ourson a dormi tout l’hiver, comme tous les ours. {sfx:snore} Il a dormi… dormi… dormi. Et Blaireau veillait. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Un matin, le soleil est revenu et la neige a fondu. {badger:go to bear} Blaireau s’est approché tout doucement. [whispers] « Réveille-toi. C’est le meilleur moment. » {bear:live nap resume} Ourson s’est réveillé en sursaut. {flower:live close resume} Fleur s’est ouverte en grand. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] « J’ai tout raté ? » {badger:live laugh} « Non, a ri Blaireau. Le meilleur moment, c’est maintenant. » {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] « Bonjour, printemps ! »

it-IT.title: Orsetto dorme fino a primavera
it-IT.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} Era autunno, e le foglie {sfx:leaves} scendevano giù volteggiando. {bear:enter} Orsetto ha fatto uno sbadiglio grande grande. {bear:face sad} [sad] «Non voglio dormire tutto l'inverno. Mi perdo tutto!» {badger:enter} {badger:go to bear} Tasso è arrivato trotterellando. [warmly] «Ti sveglio io per il momento più bello. Promesso.» {badger:live dig} Gli ha scavato un lettino caldo caldo nella terra, proprio della misura di un orso. {badger:face happy} Lì accanto, {flower:enter} Fiore {flower:tint #BFE3FF} ha tremato e {flower:live close hold} ha chiuso i petali. «Ci vediamo a primavera», ha sussurrato. {bear:face happy} Così Orsetto {bear:go to flower} si è seduto nel suo lettino e {bear:live nap hold} ha fatto un ultimo sbadiglio. {canvas:leaves stop} {canvas:snow 0.7} Poi sono arrivati i fiocchi di neve, e Orsetto ha dormito per tutto l'inverno, come fanno gli orsi. {sfx:snore} Ha dormito… e dormito… e dormito. E Tasso vegliava su di lui. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Una mattina è tornato il sole e ha sciolto la neve. {badger:go to bear} Tasso si è avvicinato in punta di piedi. [whispers] «Svegliati. È il momento più bello.» {bear:live nap resume} Orsetto si è svegliato di soprassalto. {flower:live close resume} Fiore si è aperto tutto. {bear:face surprised} {bear:live talk} [gasps] «Me lo sono perso?» {badger:live laugh} «Ma no», ha riso Tasso. «Il momento più bello è adesso.» {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} [happily] «Buongiorno, primavera!»

zh-TW.title: 小熊一覺睡到春天
zh-TW.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}秋天到了，葉子{sfx:leaves}一片一片，轉著圈圈飄下來。{bear:enter}小熊打了一個好大好大的呵欠。{bear:face sad}[sad]「我不要睡一整個冬天。這樣我會錯過好多事！」 {badger:enter}{badger:go to bear}獾小跑步過來。[warmly]「最精采的時候，我一定叫醒你。說好了！」 {badger:live dig}牠挖了一個暖呼呼的窩，大小剛好裝得下一隻小熊。{badger:face happy}旁邊的{flower:enter}小花{flower:tint #BFE3FF}冷得發抖，{flower:live close hold}把花瓣合了起來。「春天見囉。」 她小小聲地說。{bear:face happy}於是小熊{bear:go to flower}坐進窩裡，{bear:live nap hold}打了最後一個呵欠。{canvas:leaves stop}{canvas:snow 0.7}接著，雪花飄下來了。小熊睡了一整個冬天，熊就是這樣過冬的。{sfx:snore}睡呀睡……睡呀睡……獾一直在旁邊守著牠。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}有一天早上，太陽回來了，把雪都融化了。{badger:go to bear}獾躡手躡腳地走過去。[whispers]「起床囉。最精采的時候到了。」 {bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子醒過來。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。{bear:face surprised}{bear:live talk}[gasps]「我錯過了嗎？」 {badger:live laugh}「沒有啦。」 獾哈哈笑，「最精采的，就是現在！」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}[happily]「春天，早安！」

zh-HK.title: 小熊冬眠記
zh-HK.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}秋天到了，樹葉{sfx:leaves}打着轉，一片片飄下來。{bear:enter}小熊打了一個好大好大的呵欠。{bear:face sad}[sad]「我唔想成個冬天都瞓覺呀，咁我咪乜都錯過晒？」 {badger:enter}{badger:go to bear}獾小步跑過來。[warmly]「最精彩嗰陣，我一定叫醒你。應承你！」 {badger:live dig}牠掘了一個暖洋洋的窩，大小剛好容得下一隻小熊。{badger:face happy}旁邊的{flower:enter}小花{flower:tint #BFE3FF}冷得發抖，{flower:live close hold}把花瓣合了起來。「春天見。」 她輕輕地說。{bear:face happy}於是小熊{bear:go to flower}坐進窩裏，{bear:live nap hold}打了最後一個呵欠。{canvas:leaves stop}{canvas:snow 0.7}接着，雪花飄下來了。小熊睡了一整個冬天，熊就是這樣過冬的。{sfx:snore}牠睡呀睡……睡呀睡……獾一直守在牠身邊。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}一天早上，太陽回來了，把雪都融掉。{badger:go to bear}獾輕手輕腳地走過去。[whispers]「起身喇，最精彩嘅時候到喇。」 {bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子醒了過來。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。{bear:face surprised}{bear:live talk}[gasps]「我係咪錯過咗呀？」 {badger:live laugh}「冇呀。」 獾哈哈笑，「最精彩嘅，就係而家！」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}[happily]「春天，早晨！」
